fact: RobotsMali AI4D Lab published two open-source Bambara speech recognition models, Soloni TDT-CTC (114M) and QuartzNet-15x5 (19M), trained on about 35 hours of transcribed Bambara audio and released on Hugging Face for researchers and developers.
title: RobotsMali AI4D Lab Dévoile Deux Modèles Open-Source pour la Reconnaissance Vocale en Bambara
